acceptance_modes.label: Debug app acceptance
acceptance_modes.summary: Current-tree debug acceptance conveyor passes deterministic, web, accessibility, responsive, performance, Android export, and emulator native visual gates. Live Notion proof remains externally blocked by missing NOTION_TEST_PAGE_ID; signed release stays separate.

acceptance_modes.label: Signed release acceptance
acceptance_modes.summary: Android and iOS signing and release-env blockers remain separate from debug app acceptance.

issues.summary: Trusted bearer scopes enforce domain isolation across MCP resources and tools without disclosing denied target domains.
Server chat principal identity is bound to trusted bearer-token configuration; caller principal headers cannot override it.
Hosted startup fails closed without bearer auth and local-dev bypass is loopback-only.
Policy returns one exhaustive deny, clarify, review, or execute decision.
Chat, workflow steps, compensation, and undo use canonical mutation actions with transactional operation-commit outbox delivery.
Undo uses explicit undone and undo_failed lifecycle semantics with canonical receipts.
Verifier false-green hole is closed.
Canonical MCP state serializes locked read-modify-write commits; repeated eight-process proofs retained every record, action, and outbox event.
Ingress enforces body limits, total deadlines, idle progress deadlines, and header bounds.
Chat request admission atomically reserves durable principal-and-conversation-scoped idempotency keys across concurrent processes and transports.
Android debug runtime now renders on the explicit disposable emulator; native visual matrix verifies 7/7 routes with expected UI labels and screenshots.
Hidden plan hint no longer drives intent.
Chat send routes ignore client-supplied previous_response_id.
Retrieval has cache, timeout, circuit-breaker, source-budget, and freshness controls.
Notion pull paginates until target or limit.
The supervised reactive worker uses an atomic cross-process guard, owner-safe lease renewal and cleanup, and repeated eight-process single-execution proofs.
Review-required proposals persist as awaiting_review.
Canonical writes atomically persist commit events; startup and supervised worker drains provide idempotent at-least-once reactive delivery across failures and restarts.
Release readiness proof exists, but artifact terminology remains risky.
Ajv strict mode and expanded duplicate, invalid-op, and unknown-field mutants fail closed.
Real SQLite writer-boundary coverage now proves canonical user, sync, AI, undo, JSON persistence, idempotency, and transactional rollback.
Shared confidence contracts converge numeric provenance and qualitative policy semantics.

Current deterministic, web, polish, Android export, and emulator native gates pass through check:utopia-single-shot; current-head live Notion/Sheets authority remains blocked by missing NOTION_TEST_PAGE_ID.
Device mutation is emulator-bound; provider mutation requires an HMAC authorization bound to the exact provider target and account.
